problem_statement: Build a brand-new /features page from scratch on the Nuxt 3 site 'nuxtship-template'. The route /features does not exist yet (baseline returns Nuxt's 404). Create pages/features.vue using the site's landing layout (definePageMeta layout:'landing') so it inherits the shared Navbar and Footer, and reuse the existing design system (LandingContainer, LandingSectionhead, LandingLink, black/slate Tailwind tokens). The page presents a category-filtered feature showcase: a page header 'Powerful Features', a row of three category tabs (Build / Deploy / Scale), and a responsive card grid whose contents switch when a tab is clicked (a real client-side interaction). By default the 'Build' category is active and shows its three feature cards. Add a 'See Pricing' link to /pricing. The page must be consistent with sibling pages (same Navbar links + Footer) and must not overflow horizontally on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: Page uses the shared landing layout (Navbar + Footer chrome), consistent with sibling pages
Section header h1 'Powerful Features' with a descriptive subtitle
Three category tab buttons: Build, Deploy, Scale (each with a unique data-cat attribute)
Default active category 'Build' shows three feature cards: Instant Scaffolding, Component Library, Type-Safe APIs
Clicking the 'Deploy' tab swaps the grid to Deploy features (One-Click Deploy, Edge Network, Zero-Config CI) via client-side state
Responsive card grid (sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3) with no horizontal overflow at 390px
Each feature card renders its title as an <h3> (e.g. 'Instant Scaffolding', 'Component Library', 'Type-Safe APIs') with a short description paragraph below
design_constraints: Reuse the site's black + slate palette and Inter font (Tailwind tokens)
Inherit shared Navbar + Footer via layout:'landing' (cross-page consistency)
Inline the feature data as static const (no network fetch; SSG/SSR renders self-contained)

Palette tokens (from reference): page background near-white (#ffffff / slate-50), primary buttons/tabs use black background rgb(0,0,0) with white text rgb(255,255,255); body/subtitle copy in slate rgb(100,116,139); card and control borders rgb(229,231,235); border-radius 4px; Inter font family throughout
Active tab uses the solid black token (bg-black text-white); inactive tabs are outlined/muted — mirrors the reference button styling

Layout structure: shared Navbar (Nuxtship logo + links Features / Pricing / About / Contact + Log in / Sign up) at top, a centered LandingSectionhead ('Powerful Features' h1 + subtitle), the three category tabs row, then the responsive card grid, and the shared Footer (containing 'Nuxtship') at the bottom
author_notes: baseline: pages/features.vue is a layout:false empty stub (Nuxt's default 404 error page otherwise renders ~20KB 'Page not found' chrome -> not empty). reference: full category-tab feature page on the landing layout. bad: identical to reference but the tab <button> drops its @click handler -> clicking a category is a no-op, so the Deploy grid never appears -> fails ONLY the interaction gate; all other gates (dom/consistency/overflow/console) still pass. Three workspaces md5-distinct on pages/features.vue.
